source_identification: UCLA Basic Examination, May 2003, containing ten numbered problems.
deterministic_extraction_limit: The fresh MinerU Flash output is byte-identical to the retained extraction. It reproduces source-authored defects already recorded on source-checked cards: Problem 4 prints an undefined f(x,y) while calling f one-variable, Problem 5 uses an undefined s in the unit-circle equation, Problem 7 writes functionals V→F although V is real and F is undefined, and Problem 10 calls a real operator hermitian and refers to a nonexistent standard basis. Minor arrow/limit typography is also degraded. No fallback extraction or independent full-source transcription was used.
card_reconciliation: The existing complete SRC-UCLA-BASIC-SPRING-2003 collection represents all ten source positions in order with nine source-local cards plus canonical reuse of P-UCLAB05F-02 for Problem 6. All ten collection paths are byte-identical to HEAD; no collection or card path is modified by this intake.
